# Feature: Native Multiple Block browser choices

## Abstract
Expose the existing native target-specific dice and reroll prompt so block/assist visibility can continue through Multiple Block resolution.

## Objective
Let the correct coach choose each target's block dice while seeing the matching assists.

## Context / Existing Behavior
Validation of #318 and #319 found that the engine offers per-target Multiple Block dialogs but the browser adapter exposes no actions. The user explicitly approved including this prerequisite on 2026-10-20.

## In Scope
- Adapt both native attacker and opponent Multiple Block dialogs.
- Preserve target IDs, chooser ownership, offered reroll sources and die indexes.
- Target-labelled dice and skill choices; keyboard/pointer inspection changes active assists while retaining both direction markers.

## Out of Scope
- Changes to rules, eligibility, dice, native sequencing, desktop dialogs or special attacks.
- Publication, commits, pushes, PRs, merge or deployment.

## Functional Requirements
- Reuse the existing ordinary reroll catalog and native per-target command types.
- Never offer attacker-owned uphill die selection.
- Keep target labels when grouping skill choices, including Pro.
- Follow the native remaining target when control passes to the opponent.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Genuine Multiple Block resolves both targets through server-issued browser actions.
- Both contexts freeze when their individual native rolls occur.
- Mixed attacker/opponent selection, replay and recovery retain the correct context.
- Keyboard and pointer inspection select only the current target's assists.

## Constraints
- Work on feature/block-assist-visibility; preserve unrelated changes.
- Preserve MUTP colors, typography, themes and existing components on Android, Windows and Linux.
- Follow repository conventions; do not commit or push.

## Implementation Guidance
Use a small MultipleBlockPromptActions presentation adapter and the native BlockRollProperties. Keep the engine authoritative. See docs/specs/block-assist-visibility.md.

## Validation
- Native command ownership/source/index mapping and genuine mixed-choice/recovery journeys.
- Production GameView tests for target labels, grouped Pro, keyboard/pointer focus, spectators and replay seek.
- Unit/browser checks and game-server build after changes; diagnose failures until resolved or a concrete blocker remains.

## Completion Notes
Record exact checks and review fixes in docs/specs/block-assist-visibility-outcome.md and on this issue. Keep work uncommitted for review.
